description: No-RAG vs Graph-RAG comparison using the identical AlzBench prompts/retrieval/scoring code, answered directly by Claude (Sonnet 5) through the ChatClient 'manual:' mode in alzgraph/common.py instead of a third-party API call. Reproduce by re-running the commands in CODE_MANIFEST.md's Model Comparison Protocol section with an operator (human or LLM) filling in runs/manual_llm_cache.json from runs/manual_llm_queue.json.
caveats: T1 (mcq.json, qa.json) and T3 (bpm_mcq.json) items were authored by the same model instance that produced these predictions; the ceiling accuracy on those subsets reflects that the items test facts well within this model's parametric knowledge and is not evidence of generalization to unseen or adversarially-constructed items.
T4 items are externally sourced (MedQA-USMLE, not authored by the operator), which removes item-authorship bias but not the same-model-family evaluation bias.

Two T4 items (t4_4b426800a373, t4_d72f542a3b13) were excluded from this table because the operator viewed their gold labels during dataset curation QA before the blind answering pass; they remain in the released dataset and in the KG-only baseline (which does not involve operator judgment).
T5 has no gold reference plans (PMC abstracts do not carry expert-authored research plans), so it is reported as a qualitative case study, not a scored row.

t4.note: 14 of the 16 released T4 items; see caveats for the 2 excluded

t5.note: Qualitative case study only (no gold research plans exist for real PMC abstracts); see runs/t5_manual_norag_sample.json and runs/t5_manual_graphrag_sample.json for the full generations.
